paper_claim: A declared known truth is not automatically assignable; constrained representations require separate audits of structural feasibility, generator accessibility, and recovery.

figures.title: A failed known-truth simulation can fail at different inferential gates
figures.question: Does a low final recovery rate reflect failure to assign the target or failure to recover it after assignment?
panels: A: conceptual flow from declared target to structural feasibility, generator accessibility, and recovery

B: partition of the 683 systems with stored calibration diagnostics into generator no-bracket, assigned-but-S3-recovery-failed, and S3-recovery-passed outcomes, separately for continuous-scalar and nominal-categorical representations

figures.title: A hard one-transition state-space ceiling does not explain categorical calibration failure
figures.question: Do the 220 categorical OU no-bracket systems fail because even a simple realizable one-transition state cannot exceed rho=0.15, or because the OU generator does not access the benchmark?
panels: A: target rho=0.15 compared with median maximum realizable one-edge rho and median maximum OU-grid rho among the 220 original categorical no-bracket systems; the edge-split maximum is a one-sided ceiling witness, not proof of exact target attainability
B: mechanism decomposition of the 220 OU no-bracket systems into effect ceiling versus validity collapse

figures.title: Generator choice, state balance and recovery are separable bottlenecks
figures.question: How do generator choice, an exact balance-normalized diagnostic, and downstream recovery contribute to the categorical calibration bottleneck?
panels: A: mechanism sequence. OU and Mk2 use the identical rho=0.15 target; the third point holds Mk2 states and distance ranks fixed but calibrates balance-normalized Delta_rank=0.30, so it is a diagnostic re-expression rather than the identical estimand. The four geometry-HOLD systems are shown as a bounded interval.
B: paired rescue versus new-failure counts for OU->Mk2 and Mk2-rho->balance-normalized transitions
C: recovery after successful Mk2 assignment: 69 pass versus 37 recovery failures among 106 calibrated systems

supplementary: S1: trait-level categorical no-bracket heterogeneity from v0.2.1
S2: pre-frozen measurability logistic-model coefficients and cluster-bootstrap intervals
design_rules: Use aligned positions and lengths for quantitative comparisons.
Do not use a rainbow palette or rely on color alone.
Show exact denominators and target reference lines.
Show the four-system geometry-HOLD uncertainty as an interval, not an imputed point estimate.
Do not add new scientific estimands while preparing figures.
